messages.en:
{07 14 00}Tee hee hee! It's nothing
special, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}. {01 01 00}{07 00 00}But by
the way{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 0b 00}Who the heck are you,
{04 1f 00}?{01 01 00} Some kind of
fossil master?!
{07 19 00}I don't think I'll ever be
as good as you are at
dishing dirt... Tee hee hee!{07 00 00}
{07 14 00}Anyway, thanks for
everything!{01 01 00} That helped a
lot, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Hihihii! See pole midagi
erilist, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}. {01 01 00}{07 00 00}Aga
muide{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 0b 00}Kes sa õieti oled,
{04 1f 00}?{01 01 00} Mingi
fossiilimeister?!
{07 19 00}Ma vist ei saa kunagi
sinu sarnaselt heaks
mulla kaevajaks... Hihihii!{07 00 00}
{07 14 00}Igatahes, aitäh
kõige eest!{01 01 00} See aitas
palju, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}It's just a small something 
from me, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 00 00}But I gotta say{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 14 00}You're pretty good! {01 00 00 05 00}I'm so
impressed! {01 00 00 05 00}{07 19 00}If I had known
just how good you are,
I would've asked for your
help from the start!{07 00 00}

{07 04 00}So, {01 00 00 0a 00}if there's something
I can do for you, just let
me know.
{07 14 00}Depending on the request,{01 00 00 0a 00} I
might actually help you!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}See on lihtsalt väike asjake
minu käest, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 00 00}Aga pean ütlema{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 14 00}Sa oled päris hea! {01 00 00 05 00}Ma olen
nii muljet avaldatud! {01 00 00 05 00}{07 19 00}Kui
oleksin teadnud, kui hea sa
oled, oleksin sinult abi
küsinud kohe alguses!{07 00 00}

{07 04 00}Nii et, {01 00 00 0a 00}kui ma saan sinu
heaks midagi teha, anna
teada.
{07 14 00}Olenevalt palvest{01 00 00 0a 00} võin ma
sind isegi aidata!
